_doc: LOCKED acceptance criteria (training/evaluation/acceptance.py). Thresholds are never changed because results are bad: a missed threshold is FAIL. The sha256 of this file is pinned in acceptance.py; any edit makes evaluation refuse to run until the pin is changed in a reviewed commit with the reason documented as PROPOSED_CHANGE (docs/TRAINING_GO_NO_GO.md).

informed_attacker_eer.desc: A2/A3 semi-informed attacker EER, cross-session, unseen speakers

strong_pretrained_attacker_eer.desc: A1: each held-out pretrained ASV (value = minimum over ASVs)

librispeech_wer_delta_abs.desc: Whisper WER on LibriSpeech test-clean: anonymised minus original (absolute)

android_rtf.desc: real-time factor on a representative Android big core (real device only)

streaming_causal.desc: causal streaming == full-sequence, no full-utterance dependency

no_cloud_dependency.desc: strict runtime audit passes, no network permission, no runtime network dependency
